_meta.rule: max_interval_kwh = plausible_power_kw * interval_hours (0.25h). Interval delta > max_interval_kwh => flag reconnect/catch-up jump; delta < 0 => flag reset. Flagged intervals are EXCLUDED from accepted totals but NEVER deleted from the ledger; review before any production drop.
_meta.nameplate_note: No device nameplate power is exposed in Home Assistant (verified read-only: only sensor.75_qled_power exists, unrelated). All thresholds are heuristic: device-class typicals with headroom above each device's own observed max delta.
_meta.stale_note: stale_snapshots counts readings whose source 'updated' timestamp lags the snapshot by > stale_lag_min. For total_increasing counters an idle/off device legitimately shows an old 'updated' (HA writes state only on change), so a high stale count on a zero-delta device is expected, NOT necessarily a fault. The real concern is distinct_updated_timestamps == 1 (source never refreshed across the whole 24h window).
